doc.body:
Hi there,

With food advent calendars selling out before Thanksgiving, shoppers want thoughtful countdowns without stale cardboard packaging. 

Sunday Cookie Co. in Brooklyn is launching our Holiday Box of 12 ($34) as a real-butter 12-day holiday countdown. Packed with fresh favorites like Brown Butter Chocolate Chip and Pumpkin Spice Snickerdoodle, it offers a bakery-fresh alternative to mass-market advent boxes.

We would love to send a sample box to your desk this week for holiday gift guide consideration. Let us know where to ship your fresh batch.

Warmly,
Mai
Sunday Cookie Co.

trends.insight: Young hosts want grab-and-go treats to avoid holiday kitchen burnout.
trends.move: Position Box of 6 as the no-stress Friendsgiving host savior.
trends.name: Friendsgiving Handheld Dessert Demand
trends.risk: Supermarket sheet cakes and pre-made pies crowd budget grocery carts.
trends.what: Truly and Napa Cellars launched Friendsgiving kits as 52% of younger Americans plan hosting.
trends.why_us: Our Box of 6 provides an easy, shareable host gift under twenty dollars.

trends.insight: Holiday countdown boxes generate immediate pre-order frenzy before mid-November.
trends.move: Market the Holiday Box of 12 as a 12-day countdown box.
trends.name: Food Advent Calendar Early Sellouts
trends.risk: Over-committing kitchen capacity before Thanksgiving pre-orders ship.
trends.what: Bon Appétit highlighted 20 food advent calendars selling out rapidly across specialty retailers.
trends.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 functions as a natural twelve-day cookie countdown.

trends.insight: Food media crowns browned butter as the essential holiday cookie flavor profile.
trends.move: Spotlight our scratch browned butter kettle browning process on social.
trends.name: Holiday Swap Brown Butter Spotlight
trends.risk: Looking like a copycat if we reference competitor butter partnerships.
trends.what: Yahoo featured browned butter holiday swap recipes while Milk Bar partnered with Plugrà butter.
trends.why_us: Our Brown Butter Chocolate Chip is our signature flagship recipe.

trends.insight: Consumers scrutinize mega-bakery calorie counts and artificial dough additives.
trends.move: Highlight raw pantry ingredients without claiming health or dietary benefits.
trends.name: Clean Label Ingredient Scrutiny
trends.risk: Making forbidden health or low-calorie claims violates our core policy.
trends.what: Daily Meal called out Crumbl cookies as excessively unhealthy processed calorie bombs.
trends.why_us: We bake small batches with real butter, flour, and brown sugar daily.

trends.insight: Early Hanukkah gift shopping begins four weeks ahead of December fourth.
trends.move: Prepare holiday box messaging welcoming winter festival hosts and gatherings.
trends.name: Early Hanukkah Gifting Spotlights
trends.risk: We do not hold kosher certification, limiting strict observant households.
trends.what: Disney and cultural venues launched early Hanukkah celebrations and retail collections.
trends.why_us: Our blue-ribbon gift boxes fit eight nights of celebratory family dessert.

trends.insight: Cereal inclusions and bread flour textures capture baker engagement online.
trends.move: Monitor texture discussions while keeping our production strictly focused.
trends.name: Viral Cereal Crunch Bakes
trends.risk: Distracts kitchen operations from holiday gift box shipping volumes.
trends.what: Anti-Chef revisited Christina Tosi's Milk Bar cornflake marshmallow cookie technique.
trends.why_us: We focus on classic browned butter doughs rather than cereal gimmicks.

trends.insight: National fast food chains announce free meals and twenty percent discounts.
trends.move: Pass entirely on discount wars and honor veterans without sales ploys.
trends.name: Veterans Day Freebie Promotions
trends.risk: Violates our brand policy against commercial discounts and margin loss.
trends.what: Target, Starbucks, In-N-Out, and Applebee's rolled out free Veterans Day food deals.
trends.why_us: Our policy strictly prohibits discounting cookies or giving promotional freebies.

trends.insight: Chains push raw edible dough cups to generate quick stunt traffic.
trends.move: Skip raw dough stunts to emphasize freshly baked crisp edges.
trends.name: Scoopable Cookie Dough Tubs
trends.risk: Selling raw dough undermines our warm, fresh-baked counter identity.
trends.what: Crumbl introduced scoopable raw dough bowls to capture fast viral novelty.
trends.why_us: We are a bakery serving warm, fresh-baked small-batch cookies.
